results.problem: Partition-family Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (IVF distance scan)
results.bound: N + 4RK \text{ INT8 product streams (dominant work), vs. } 4N \text{ for full byte-split scan}
results.quote: For _N_ probed candidates, a full byte-split scan performs four INT8 product streams per candidate, for a total cost of 4_N_. The cascade instead performs one stream for all candidates and four streams for only the \(R\cdot K\) survivors, yielding dominant work of _N_ + 4_RK_.
By Eq. 1, the scan becomes _compute-bound_ once \(M_\mathrm{eff}\ge M^\star=\frac{\pi}{\beta}\).
